question: In a certain code language, “DILQ” is written as “FKNS” and “SBGK” is written as “UDIM”. How will “FORA” be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the tables given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cd384326ab4a9517974d454ae1e8cdfffacc701227c31d3b0c3e16054bc87d6.png] ​

**Logic: 'Addition of '2' to the positional value of the letters'**

“DILQ” is written as “FKNS” →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6786ceca3ba6b7d4db279bee1745a6b35555c2aebc325d8d690aa265ddafdbcb.png] 

“SBGK” is written as “UDIM” →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36dfcbd3b8d3615f912ae85c7e21a7cd5bc92815d458bfd73d1cb04def4fa20c.png] 

Similarly, "FORA" will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aaf67840f7ffcb6d25289eeaf2ae87fe9088d90873f221cdb0ef5fc7d00a417.png] 

Here, "FORA" is written as **"HQTC".**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
